utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, thanks—keep asking around and let me know who can bring tools or help out. I’ll keep passing the word along too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll keep asking around and let you know who can bring tools or help out. Thanks for passing the word along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. Let me know if you hear anyone who can bring tools or lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Rey—I appreciate it. Just give me a shout when it starts, and I’ll bring my toolbox over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Gus—I’ll let you know as soon as we get it rolling.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—looking forward to it. I’ll keep my toolbox ready and be there when you give the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Eli — I’ve got the supplies check started, and I’m putting together the missing list now. I’ll bring it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s exactly what we need. Bring it over when it’s ready, and we’ll get the jobs sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll finish the list and bring it over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—I’ve been a bit out of the loop. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah — no rush. Just let me know what time it ends up being, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll check on the timing and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on for the repair drive this weekend—thanks. If you can, bring the tools and any spare screws, and I’ll sort through them when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll bring what I can. Thanks, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Uli — just bring whatever tools and screws you find, and I’ll check through them when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and send folks over in small batches so pickup stays organized. Just keep me posted on what tools or help you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still a bit behind, but I can jump in where it matters most. Is the fence fix still the biggest thing left?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — the fence fix is still the main thing, and any extra hands or tools for that would be a big help. I’ll keep sending people over in small batches as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new details yet, but I’ll keep asking around while I’m out. If you learn the room, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll let you know if I hear anything. Let’s keep narrowing down the urgent jobs so the drive is focused.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll keep asking around while I’m out and share anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—Saturday morning still works for me, and I’ll keep an eye on the pickup list so nothing gets missed. We should probably confirm the tools and spare parts before then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll check the community center for the exact room and confirm the tools and spare parts before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — that should help. If you can send me the room details when you have them, I’ll make sure the pickup list stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — the repair drive is really happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, it’s happening — I’m still catching up on the latest, though. If you know what’s been decided, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I just wanted to make sure. If anything changes, let me know before I tell the others.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on, and folks are bringing in tools and old parts this afternoon. If you’re heading over, I’d go sooner rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by soon and pass along any houses that need help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Bo — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep my ears open and pass along any new houses that need work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I can put your name down too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Point me to the fence fix when you’re ready and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll point you to the fence fix, and I’ll keep letting the neighbors know about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list updated for any new homes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep sending over any homes I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — thank you. I’ll keep the list organized and make sure the fence fix and tool sorting stay front and center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 should work for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, Saturday at 10 works for me too. I’m still catching up—do we have a clear list of which repairs need the most help?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but I can help sort that out with the group and see which repairs are highest priority.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, absolutely—I’m keeping it organized for Sunday at the community center. If you know any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send any homes your way. We still need a few tools and spare parts, and I can help keep track of pickups so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Pia — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll add the tools and spare parts to the list and keep everything lined up for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, I just want to confirm — you’re really coming to the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m coming—I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll tell the others you’re in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m still keeping things low-key, but I appreciate you asking—I'll help where I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Uli — I’ll keep passing the word along. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll help keep folks in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll do my best to help quietly and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m in for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can jump in too—what’s the biggest thing left right now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks for jumping in, Dane. The biggest thing left is sorting the repairs by priority, so let’s start there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list nearly ready, Leo — I’ll bring over what’s still missing for the repair drive as soon as I finish it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Leo — I should have it wrapped up soon, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still headed to the community center to check the exact room for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal — just tell me the room when you find it. I’ll keep the urgent list ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m heading there now, and I’ll send you the exact room as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out, just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. First we need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job, then we can get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can help make that list. Just tell me the broken items and who’s on each one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — if you’re heading to the repair drive, I can bring my toolbox over and help sort out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Gus — thanks for bringing your toolbox. I’ll keep asking around and send anyone your way who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know when it starts, and I’ll head over with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’m still a bit behind on the repair drive, so I should check what’s new and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem, Noah — the fence fix and sorting the donated tools are still the main things left. Get back to me when you can, and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check on what’s left and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s set, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and help get a clear list together. Just send me the broken items and who’s handling what, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good—I'll send over the broken items and names once I have them. That should make it easier to get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — that should help a lot. If you can, please also bring a small flashlight and some tape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any houses that need help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — that would be really helpful. Please let me know if you hear of any urgent repairs.
